note: Color-picker drag fix — the real entropy source. Native color picker fires input events continuously while the user drags through the palette. The in-menu handler was calling setIndicatorColor on each one which triggers a full renderChart — 60+ chart rebuilds per second of drag. That was the lag, not the luminos. Fix: split input from change. Input updates the label color as a live cheap preview. Change is the single commit path that persists and re-renders. Same principle scales — less machine work means less waiting on both sides of the glass.
